result.summary: The image depicts a multi-lane one-way urban street with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the wide roadway width and lack of physical traffic calming measures may facilitate higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Multi-lane one-way configuration
hazards.description: Three lanes of one-way traffic can encourage higher vehicle speeds and create 'multiple threat' scenarios where a pedestrian is hidden by a stopped vehicle in one lane while another vehicle approaches in an adjacent lane.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation in crosswalk
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patching within the crosswalk area can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians and reduce the long-term visibility of the markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light, reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and prioritize pedestrian movement.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and well-maintained sidewalks in an institutional setting. result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. A marked bike lane is visible on the right, and the environment is enhanced by street trees and lighting, though the crossing distance remains relatively wide without a median refuge.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a central refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the crosswalk area could pose a minor tripping hazard or reduce the visibility of markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time safely.

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repave the intersection and refresh crosswalk markings to ensure a smooth, high-visibility surface for all users.
